claims: The 68th Annual Grammy Awards took place on February 1, 2026.
The 68th Annual Grammy Awards took place at Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles.
Trevor Noah hosted the 68th Annual Grammy Awards.
Kendrick Lamar won five awards at the 68th Annual Grammy Awards.
Kendrick Lamar won Record of the Year for "Luther" at the 68th Annual Grammy Awards.
Kendrick Lamar won Best Rap Album for GNX at the 68th Annual Grammy Awards.
Kendrick Lamar became the most-awarded rapper in history.
Bad Bunny won Album of the Year at the 68th Annual Grammy Awards.
Bad Bunny was the first artist to win Album of the Year with a Spanish-language LP.
Billie Eilish and Finneas won Song of the Year at the 68th Annual Grammy Awards.
Billie Eilish and Finneas won Song of the Year for the third time.
"Golden" won Best Song Written for Visual Media at the 68th Annual Grammy Awards.
K-pop's first Grammy win was "Golden" winning Best Song Written for Visual Media.
Bruno Mars performed at the 2026 Grammy Awards.
Lady Gaga performed at the 2026 Grammy Awards.
Post Malone performed at the 2026 Grammy Awards.
Sabrina Carpenter performed at the 2026 Grammy Awards.
Lainey Wilson performed at the 2026 Grammy Awards.
The 2026 Grammy Awards featured a special Best New Artist segment featuring Olivia Dean and The Marías.
Trevor Noah hosted the 2026 Grammy Awards for the sixth consecutive year.
The 2026 Grammy Awards was Trevor Noah's final time hosting the ceremony.
The 2026 Grammy Awards was broadcast live on CBS.
The 2026 Grammy Awards was streamed on Paramount+.
Olivia Dean won Best New Artist at the 2026 Grammy Awards.
The 2026 Grammy Awards recognized recordings released between August 31, 2024, and August 30, 2025.
